name: claude-bell
description: Chime in your VS Code window when Claude Code finishes its turn or waits for you — works over SSH, Remote and WSL, because the sound plays on your machine, not on the server. Self-contained (installs its own Claude Code hook), no telemetry, Linux included.

commands.title: Claude Bell: Add a sound file to your sounds
Claude Bell: Add a sound file to your sounds (alias)
Claude Bell: Install hook into Claude Code
Claude Bell: Remove hook from Claude Code

claudeBell.enabled.description: Ring when Claude Code finishes its turn or waits for you.

claudeBell.sound.description: Which sound to play: desk, desk-double, soft, classic, or custom:<file name> for a sound from your sounds folder. Pick it in the Claude Bell panel.

claudeBell.soundsFolder.description: Your sound library folder on the machine where Claude Code runs. Every audio file in it is a card in the panel; + adds files (converted to WAV), × deletes them. Empty means ~/.claude/claude-bell/sounds.

claudeBell.soundFile.description: Legacy: a file set here is imported into your sounds folder on the next start and the setting is cleared.

claudeBell.signalFile.description: Signal file the hook appends to. Empty means ~/.claude/.claude-bell-signal on the machine where Claude Code runs.

claudeBell.installHook.description: Install and keep Claude Bell's own hook in Claude Code's user settings (~/.claude/settings.json on the machine where Claude Code runs). Turn off if you manage Claude Code hooks yourself.
